name: Mobius Roid
source:
The main protagonist of "Mobius Roid" is a young man named Taniyama Makoto, who lives alone in a mansion in a quiet district, and dedicates most of his time to one activity: sex. He also has a partner to his sexual escapades, a very "active" young girl named Chie. But another young girl is raped somewhere in the neighborhood, and this changes Makoto's life...

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/mbius-roid]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《Mobius Roid》的主人公谷山真是一名独居青年，住在宁静街区的一座宅邸里。他把大部分时间都投入同一件事：性爱。性欲十分旺盛的少女横山智惠，则是陪他四处寻欢的固定伴侣。然而，附近又有另一名少女遭到强奸，这起事件彻底改变了他的生活……

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/mbius-roid]Moby Games[/url]]
